name_zh: 哥伦比亚·阿尔瓦罗·乌里韦：民主安全与反游击阿尔瓦罗模式
name_en: Colombia Alvaro Uribe: Democratic Security & Anti-Guerrilla Alvaro Model
description_zh: 阿尔瓦罗·乌里韦 (1952-) 哥伦比亚总统 (2002-2010)，民主安全政策军事打击哥伦比亚革命武装力量(FARC)，巴拉圭外交斡旋释放人质，连任修宪争议，安全成果与人权代价并存。
description_en: Alvaro Uribe (1952-) Colombia President (2002-2010), democratic security policy militarily struck FARC, Paraguay diplomacy mediated hostage release, re-election constitutional controversy, security gains and human rights costs coexisted.
reason_zh: 乌里韦代表哥伦比亚如何通过军事强力与外交斡旋双重手段压制半个世纪游击战争，展示了民主安全政策如何在人权批评中获得国内民众压倒性支持，其阿尔瓦罗模式影响拉美安全议程。
reason_en: Uribe represents how Colombia suppressed half-century guerrilla war through military force and diplomatic mediation dual approach, demonstrating how democratic security policy gained overwhelming domestic support despite human rights criticism, his Alvaro model influencing Latin American security agenda.
steps_zh: 研究乌里韦早年安蒂奥基亚州长与反绑架专家经历
分析2002年民主安全政策军事化与准军事合作
探讨2008年巴拉圭外交斡旋英格丽德·贝唐古尔释放
评估2006连任修宪与2010年宪法法院否决第三任
总结民主安全反游击阿尔瓦罗模式对拉美反叛乱战略的影响
steps_en: Study Uribe early Antioquia Governor and anti-kidnapping expert experience
Analyze 2002 democratic security policy militarization and paramilitary cooperation
Explore 2008 Paraguay diplomacy mediation Ingrid Betancourt release
Evaluate 2006 re-election constitutional amendment and 2010 Court rejection third term
Summarize democratic security anti-guerrilla Alvaro model impact on Latin American counterinsurgency strategy
expected_zh: 掌握军事强力与外交斡旋如何双轮驱动反游击战争，理解安全成果与人权代价的民主权衡困境，评估乌里韦模式对墨西哥中美洲等国安全政策的外溢影响。
expected_en: Master how military force and diplomatic mediation dual-wheel drive counter-guerrilla war, understand democratic trade-off dilemma between security gains and human rights costs, evaluate Uribe model spillover impact on Mexico Central America security policies.
case_zh: 2002 总统；2008 贝唐古尔释放；2010 卸任；持续影响。民主安全反游击阿尔瓦罗范式永存。
case_en: 2002 President; 2008 Betancourt release; 2010 retirement; ongoing influence. Democratic security anti-guerrilla Alvaro paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Counterinsurgency model; hostage rescue; constitutional controversy; human rights
